title: OpenCode
description: opencode telemetry collected over OTLP: traces in Tempo, logs in Loki. Adapted from grafana.com dashboard 25337, which targets Application Insights. Every aggregate panel uses TraceQL metrics, which require Tempo's local-blocks processor.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: TraceQL has no distinct-count, so this groups by session.id and counts the resulting series.

panels.title: LLM Calls
panels.description: AI SDK streamText spans -- one per model invocation.

panels.title: Cache Read %
panels.description: Share of input tokens served from the provider prompt cache. Higher is cheaper.

panels.title: Errored Spans
panels.description: Any opencode span whose OTel status is ERROR.

panels.title: Tool Failure %
panels.description: Share of tool executions that ended in an error status.

panels.title: Cache Write %
panels.description: Share of input tokens written into the prompt cache.

panels.title: Prompt p95
panels.description: 95th percentile wall time of a full user turn.

panels.title: LLM Calls by Model
panels.description: Calls per interval, split by model.

panels.title: Token Usage Over Time
panels.description: Input, output and cache-read tokens. All three are token counts, so they share one axis -- never a second y-scale.

panels.title: Tokens by Host
panels.description: host.name is set by the opencode wrapper in modules/home/ai/opencode.

panels.title: Recent Prompts
panels.description: Click a trace ID to open the full span tree.

panels.title: opencode Logs
panels.description: Loki ingests these through its native OTLP endpoint, so service_name comes from the OTel resource.
